_comment: Example configuration for clossify. Copy to .local/config.json and fill real values. Never commit real credentials. All values below are placeholders. Keys: naver (Commerce API), naver_searchad (Search Ads keyword API), image_providers (image generation), smartstore_notice_defaults (product information notice / origin), kc_declaration (KC certification reporting). The agent documents use placeholders {AS_TEL}, {STORE_SLUG}, {STORE_NAME}, {VISION_MODEL} which are resolved from this config at runtime.

naver._comment: Naver Commerce API OAuth2 client_credentials. client_secret is used as the bcrypt signing key in naver_client.get_token.

naver_searchad._comment: Naver SearchAds (keyword volume) API. Used for SEO title keyword ranking.

image_providers._comment: Paid image generation providers for detail-page cut shortages. See agents/IMAGE_GENERATION_PRICE_POLICY.md.

brand._comment: Placeholders resolved into agent documents and rendered detail pages.

smartstore_notice_defaults._comment: 상품정보제공고시 자동완성 기본값. 판매자가 실제 신고하는 값을 입력. 미입력 시 등록이 거부됩니다 (fail-closed, 조용한 기본값 금지).

kc_declaration._comment: KC 인증 신고값. 판매자가 실제 신고하는 값을 입력. 미입력 시 등록이 거부됩니다 (fail-closed, 조용한 기본값 금지).kcCertifiedProductExclusionYn / kcExemptionType 두 값 중 하나라도 비어있으면 KC 필드 전체가 payload에서 생략되며, 네이버 커머스 API가 요구하면 에러로 알려줍니다.
